# Synthetic media fixtures

These fixtures are generated by this project's `scripts/generate-fixtures.mjs`:

- `hls-segment.bin`: three seconds of FFmpeg `testsrc2` color patterns and a 440 Hz sine wave, H.264 / AAC in MPEG-TS.
- `dash-video.mp4`: the same synthetic color pattern, H.264 in fragmented MP4.
- `dash-audio.mp4`: the same generated sine wave, AAC in fragmented MP4.

They contain no downloaded website video, personal media, music or user data. They are provided under the project's MIT license along with their generation script. FFmpeg is an optional generation tool; it is not distributed with the extension or needed to run tests.

With FFmpeg (including `libx264` and AAC encoders) installed:

```sh
node scripts/generate-fixtures.mjs
npm test
```

Set `STREAM_LENS_FFMPEG` to use a specific FFmpeg binary. Fixtures are checked in so `npm ci && npm test` works without FFmpeg.
